entities.name: PMID:27505325
observations: Primary study examined HMOX1 promoter GT-repeat length and cilostazol effects in rat carotid injury and cultured human vascular smooth muscle cells.
Cilostazol increased HO-1 expression; HO-1 knockdown attenuated cilostazol-mediated inhibition of VSMC proliferation.
Shorter HMOX1 promoter GT-repeat alleles showed greater cilostazol-induced HO-1 transcription, proliferation inhibition, and promoter chromatin effects than longer alleles.
The study did not establish genotype-stratified cilostazol effects on VSMC migration.

entities.name: HMOX1
observations: The HMOX1 promoter GT-repeat length was inversely related to cilostazol-induced HO-1 transcription in cultured human VSMCs; shorter alleles showed greater induction.
HO-1 mediated part of cilostazol's anti-proliferative effect, based on attenuation after HO-1 knockdown.

entities.name: Cilostazol
observations: Cilostazol, a PDE3 inhibitor, induced HO-1 and inhibited VSMC proliferation in the reported models; effects were stronger with shorter HMOX1 promoter GT-repeat alleles.

entities.name: Vascular smooth muscle cells
observations: Cultured human VSMCs were used to test cilostazol-induced HO-1 expression and proliferation inhibition across HMOX1 promoter GT-repeat lengths.
